takeon_triangle.evidence: This 2021 report never mentions Syndicate 6130 or any RITC accepted in 2021. Its only RITC is a subsequent event: p6 'Effective 1 January 2022, the Syndicate accepted the reinsurance to close (RITC) of the liabilities of Syndicate 2088 for the 2019 Year of Account'; p37 note 26 on the same 2022 transaction ('$136.6m and $95.0m' gross and net technical provisions). The scan's quote comes from the prior year's report, syndicate_1084_2020 p35 note 28. It says 6130 'only reinsured the Syndicate, as host', and the RITC transferred 'gross and net technical provisions, including deferred acquisition costs, of $40.4m and $22.5m'. It adds: 'effective 1 January 2021, the Syndicate will de-recognise the $35.4m recoverable from Syndicate 6130, recognise an additional $5.0m in gross technical provisions'. So the gross addition is about $5.0m. The p31 step for UW years to 2019 is a release in every year from 2014 (2018 column: 903.9-941.9 = -38.0), totalling -206.2. A take-on of at most $5.0m (or $40.4m before derecognition) is small beside it and cannot be more than half of a -206.2 figure. takeon_amount_m is the $40.4m stated in the 2020 report; the 2021 report states no amount.

takeon_triangle.evidence: A transfer did happen in the report year. p5: 'During the year the Syndicate entered into two significant contracts being the RITC of all Syndicate 5678's open years of account and the ADC of certain years of account of Syndicates 33 and 3624 (Hiscox ADC)'; p33: 'the RITC of Syndicate 5678's 2018 and 2019 underwriting years of account into Syndicate 1110'. But the p37 table restates earlier diagonals to include the acquired business, so it does not enter the step. The 2018 column has a full history from its first diagonal (44,984 at end of underwriting year; 100,979; 105,633; 113,604; 115,426), though Syndicate 1110 wrote no 2018 year of account of its own: the prior year's report, syndicate_1110_2021 p28, has columns 2020 2019 2017 2016 2015 2014 2013 2012. The prior-year diagonals are much larger than that report showed for the same dates, e.g. 2017 at 31 Dec 2021: 149,880 (48 months, p37) against 25,052 (syndicate_1110_2021 p28), and 2017 at end of underwriting year 91,445 against 16,398. The Hiscox ADC sits in the 2022 column (131,926), outside the sum. The whole step for 2013-2020 is +9,082. Gross claims incurred in 2022 were 353,805 (p27 note 3), and gross written premium rose 'from £1.4m to £333.4m' with 'The Syndicate 5678 RITC and Hiscox ADC ... the main drivers' (p6), so a take-on of that scale is not inside a £9.1m step. The report states no transferred reserve amount for the 5678 RITC, so takeon_amount_m is null.
